purpose: bounded bibliographic source qualification, not systematic review or experimental validation

A.query: SRC:MED AND (TITLE_ABS:CaSR OR TITLE_ABS:"calcium-sensing receptor") AND (TITLE_ABS:kokumi OR TITLE_ABS:saltiness OR TITLE_ABS:salty OR TITLE_ABS:taste) AND (TITLE_ABS:peptide OR TITLE_ABS:peptides) AND FIRST_PDATE:[1900-01-01 TO 2026-10-28]

B.query: SRC:MED AND TITLE_ABS:kokumi AND (TITLE_ABS:receptor OR TITLE_ABS:activation OR TITLE_ABS:cells OR TITLE_ABS:cellular) AND FIRST_PDATE:[1900-01-01 TO 2026-10-28]

interpretation: False means no newly qualified complete target panel was recovered in this assessment; never no biological activity or proof of absence in unseen methods.
limitations: MEDLINE-source title/abstract terms, indexing and date cutoff limit coverage
abstract-only screens do not establish absence in unseen full text
all inspected evidence is development material
earlier706-hit query returned only100 and is not an exhaustive screen
no full abstract corpus is redistributed
